messages:
marta.docs: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/459 — 'SmartRouting: params & fallback examples' :wave:

marta.docs: blocking question: does SmartRouting keep client request params (stop, temperature, function_call) when it falls back to a different model? the migration guide example assumes yes, and reviewers flagged it.

nate.runtime: yes — runtime preserves request fields. we only change model_id and adjust tokenization heuristics for max_tokens. so stop/temperature/function_call/user are forwarded.

asha.api: good to know. docs should say "always supply explicit request params if you require deterministic behavior; runtime will forward them during fallback."

marta.docs: will add that. any edge cases?

nate.runtime: edge: when fallback changes tokenizer family (BPE vs sentencepiece), character-to-token mapping differs — max_tokens truncation can behave differently. add a short caveat.

marta.docs: adding a one-line caveat + two snippets (JS SDK + minimal REST). also saw linkcheck failed on a local anchor in the migration guide preview.

docs-preview-bot: "Preview build #3011 finished — status: linkcheck_failed" https://deployments.redwood-inference.dev/preview/459

marta.docs: fixing link and re-pushing. asking for quick reviews after preview green; prefer merge before 16:30 PT to avoid end-of-day deploy risk.

asha.api: I'll review snippets once preview is up. tiny nit: use the same param names as other pages (stop vs stop_tokens).

nate.runtime: once the caveat and snippets are in, i'm happy to approve. ping me if linkcheck still fails.

docs-preview-bot: "Preview build #3012 finished — status: success" https://deployments.redwood-inference.dev/preview/459

marta.docs: pushed final changes, requesting reviews. planning to merge after approvals and CI green. thanks! :rocket:
